column1: 164|orchestration|Repair related findings as one owned change wave before scoped re-review.^把相关发现交给一个负责人统一修复，再限定范围复评。|Final review finds three related null-handling defects in one module.^终评发现同一模块三个相关 null 处理缺陷。|Spawn one fixer per finding to edit the same file concurrently.^每个发现派一个修复者，并发编辑同一文件。|Give one fixer the complete finding list, fixed base revision and owned module. Require evidence for each fix and one combined validation run; review the resulting fix diff against all three findings.^把完整问题列表、固定基线版本和模块归属交给一位修复者。每项修复需证据，统一验证一次；按三个问题复评最终修复 diff。|One owner can resolve interacting edits without competing patches.~The fix report maps every finding to a change and covering check.^同一负责人能处理交互修改，避免补丁冲突。~修复报告把每个发现对应到修改与覆盖检查。|Separate truly independent ownership areas when batching would hide unrelated risks.^真正独立的归属领域可分开，避免批次掩盖无关风险。

165|workflow|Size a task as a unit that can receive a coherent review verdict.^把任务划为可形成一致评审结论的单元。|Split a feature into parser changes and UI changes.^把功能拆成解析器和 UI 改动。|Create one task per line, or one task for the entire product.^每行创建一个任务，或整个产品只创建一个任务。|Parser task owns its input contract, parsing behavior and tests. UI task consumes that contract and owns interaction tests. Each has one acceptance verdict; keep coupled signature changes together rather than splitting them across uncoordinated tasks.^解析器任务拥有输入契约、解析行为与测试；UI 任务消费契约并拥有交互测试。各有一个验收结论；耦合签名改动放一起，不拆成失协调任务。|Reviewable behavior supplies a boundary more useful than raw line counts.~A reviewer can accept or reject each task using its own criteria.^可评审行为比原始行数更适合划边界。~评审可按各自标准接受或拒绝每个任务。|Large cross-cutting changes may need integration tasks; task size is a judgment, not a universal file limit.^大型横切改动可能需集成任务；任务大小是判断，不是通用文件上限。

166|context|Transfer binding global values without paraphrasing their meaning.^传递全局约束值，不通过改述改变含义。|A plan requires exactly net472 and net8.0 across several tasks.^计划要求多个任务统一使用 net472 与 net8.0。|Tell each worker to use the old and latest runtimes.^告诉每位工作者使用旧版和最新版运行时。|Global constraints from spec: targets=[net472, net8.0]; preserve public signatures. Copy this block into each task brief or reference its fixed artifact. Review outputs against these exact targets, not inferred 'latest'.^规格全局约束：targets=[net472, net8.0]；保留公共签名。每个任务简报复制此块或引用固定产物。按准确目标评审，不推断“最新”。|Exact values preserve constraints that vague summaries silently change.~Every task consumes the same recorded target list.^准确值保留模糊摘要可能悄悄改变的约束。~每个任务消费同一已记目标列表。|Do not copy unrelated instructions blindly; identify the authoritative revision and applicable scope.^不盲目复制无关指令；明确权威版本与适用范围。

167|orchestration|Declare each task's consumed and produced interfaces before separate execution.^独立执行前声明每个任务消费与产出的接口。|One worker adds clearLayers while another wires its caller.^一个工作者实现 clearLayers，另一个连接调用方。|Implement the cleaner; the caller can guess its signature later.^实现清理器，调用方之后再猜签名。|Task A produces clearLayers(layerIds: string[]): Promise<void>. Task B consumes exactly that exported signature and awaits it. Both briefs cite the same interface artifact; validate import, argument and return compatibility.^任务 A 产出 clearLayers(layerIds: string[]): Promise<void>；任务 B 消费同一导出签名并 await。两个简报引用同一接口产物，验证 import、参数和返回兼容。|A shared contract exposes inter-task drift before integration.^共同契约在集成前显露任务间漂移。~The consumer compiles against the producer's exact exported interface.^共同契约在集成前显露任务间漂移。~消费方针对产出方准确导出接口编译。|An interface contract must be versioned and updated for agreed changes, not frozen against all evolution.^接口契约须版本化，获准变化时更新，不禁止全部演进。

170|workflow|Offer optional capabilities when the current task establishes their concrete benefit.^当前任务确有收益时，再提议可选能力。|A draft becomes visually complex enough to benefit from a diagram.^草稿变得复杂，使用图有明确收益。|Before reading the draft, ask about every visualization feature available.^读草稿前询问全部可用可视化功能。|Read the draft first. When the dependency section contains several interacting paths, offer one diagram with a sentence explaining what it clarifies. Continue plain-text work while the optional choice remains unanswered.^先读草稿。依赖章节出现多条交互路径时，提议一个图，并用一句话解释能澄清什么。可选选择未回答时继续纯文本工作。|A visible task need makes an optional offer meaningful rather than speculative.^实际任务需要让可选提议有意义，不只是猜测。~The offer names the relevant section and a specific reader benefit.^实际任务需要让可选提议有意义，不只是猜测。~提议指向相关章节和具体读者收益。|Do not defer mandatory authorization or accessibility requirements as optional features.^不把必需授权或无障碍要求推迟为可选功能。

171|skill-authoring|Separate portable capability instructions from host-specific tool bindings.^把可移植能力指令与宿主工具绑定分开。|Use one review skill on hosts with different source-read tool names.^在源码读取工具名不同的宿主复用评审技能。|Hardcode mcp_vendor_read everywhere and assume every host exposes it.^到处硬编码 mcp_vendor_read，假定每个宿主都提供。|Core instruction: retrieve source by returned path. Adapter A binds that to source_read; Adapter B binds it to documented local-file read. Select one adapter from known host capabilities; unknown host returns a capability gap.^核心指令：按返回路径读取源码。适配器 A 绑定 source_read；B 绑定已记录本地文件读取。按已知宿主能力选一个；未知宿主报告能力缺口。|A binding layer preserves task semantics while changing concrete interfaces.^绑定层保留任务语义，只改变具体接口。~Each host uses an available documented tool for the same read operation.^绑定层保留任务语义，只改变具体接口。~各宿主用可用、已记录工具完成相同读取。|Capability verbs still need real adapters and schemas; abstraction does not create unavailable tools.^能力动词仍需实际适配器与 schema；抽象不会创造缺失工具。

173|tools|Report a missing capability and take only a documented fallback.^报告缺失能力，仅采用有文档的回退。|A connector search returns no issue-creation action for the requested service.^连接器搜索没有返回请求服务的 issue 创建操作。|Invent create_issue and report the ticket was created.^编造 create_issue 并报告工单已创建。|Record that discovery returned no supported create action. Do not call a guessed slug. Prepare a local ticket draft if permitted, label it not submitted, and identify the documented setup or alternative the user can use.^记录发现未返回受支持创建操作，不调用猜测 slug。获准时准备本地工单草稿，标为未提交，并说明有文档的配置或替代方案。|The fallback keeps useful work distinct from fabricated execution.^回退保留有用工作，并与虚构执行区分。~No external ticket ID is claimed without an actual creation response.^回退保留有用工作，并与虚构执行区分。~没有实际创建响应就不声称外部工单 ID。|A frozen repository's availability note is not proof of today's connector capabilities.^冻结仓库的可用性说明不能证明今天的连接器能力。

174|evaluation|Scope upgrade advice to behavior the current code can actually reach.^把升级建议限定到当前代码实际可达的行为。|Audit a framework upgrade with many documented breaking changes.^审核有大量已记录破坏性变化的框架升级。|List every global breaking change as a confirmed defect in this project.^把所有全局破坏性变化列为项目已确认缺陷。|Inventory imported APIs and traced callers. Intersect that set with version-specific changes. For each reachable change show the local path and required check; list unobserved runtime-loaded APIs as a coverage gap.^列导入 API 与已追踪调用方，和版本变化求交集。每个可达变化展示本地路径及所需检查；未观察运行时加载 API 列为覆盖缺口。|Reachability distinguishes applicable risk from general migration documentation.^可达性区分实际适用风险与通用迁移文档。~Every confirmed local concern has a code path or explicitly provisional dynamic assumption.^可达性区分实际适用风险与通用迁移文档。~每个本地问题有代码路径，或明确暂定的动态假设。|Static reachability can miss reflection and plugins; do not claim complete absence from imports alone.^静态可达性可能漏掉反射和插件；不能只凭 imports 声称完全不存在。

175|evaluation|Distinguish tool presence, feasible execution and observed execution in reports.^报告中区分工具存在、可执行、实际执行三种状态。|A security scanner is installed but cannot authenticate to this project.^安全扫描器已安装，但无法对项目认证。|The scanner is installed, so report security coverage complete.^扫描器已安装，所以报告安全覆盖完整。|Record present=yes, runnable=no, ran=no, reason=authentication unavailable. Keep static findings separate from scanner findings. Only attach scanner coverage when a recorded run at the audited revision produced evidence.^记录 present=yes、runnable=no、ran=no、reason=认证不可用。静态发现与扫描器发现分开；只有审核版本的运行产生记录证据才计入扫描覆盖。|Presence is not execution, and execution is not success unless results are inspected.^存在不等于执行，未检查结果的执行也不等于成功。~The report cannot count an unrun scanner as completed coverage.^存在不等于执行，未检查结果的执行也不等于成功。~报告不能把未运行扫描器计为完成覆盖。|A successful invocation may still have skipped files; record actual scope and output.^成功调用仍可能跳过文件；须记录实际范围与输出。

176|evaluation|Compare baseline and candidate behavior on identical inputs, including failures.^在相同输入上比较基线与候选行为，包括失败。|Upgrade a serializer while promising unchanged public output.^升级序列化器，并承诺公共输出不变。|Run only the new suite; if it passes, assert full equivalence.^只运行新版本测试，通过就断言完全等价。|Run the same frozen fixtures on old and new serializers. Compare output bytes or the agreed semantic normalization, error type and ordering. Record every delta, including a failure present in both versions; add fixtures for known boundary inputs.^同一冻结夹具运行旧、新序列化器，比较字节或约定语义归一、错误类型、顺序。记录每个差异，包括两版均有的失败；为已知边界输入增加夹具。|A differential oracle tests preservation rather than only a candidate's own pass label.^差分判据检查行为保留，不只看候选自有通过标签。~No unexplained output or error delta exists in the tested fixture set.^差分判据检查行为保留，不只看候选自有通过标签。~已测夹具中没有未解释输出或错误差异。|Equivalence is limited to the fixtures and comparison definition; it is not proof for all inputs.^等价性受夹具和比较定义限制，不证明所有输入。

177|tools|Exercise a capability on a small real input before relying on its availability.^依赖能力前，先用一个小型真实输入试运行。|A source analyzer may exist but lack the parser for this project's language.^源码分析器存在，但可能缺项目语言解析器。|command -v analyzer succeeded, so schedule the full analysis.^command -v analyzer 成功，就安排完整分析。|Check the binary, then run its documented read-only syntax probe on one representative project file. Inspect exit code and parser diagnostics. If unsupported, record capability unavailable and choose a documented alternative.^检查程序后，对一个代表性项目文件运行其已记录只读语法探测，检查退出码和解析诊断。不支持时记录能力不可用，并选有文档替代方案。|A real probe tests the needed behavior instead of mere installation.^真实探测检查所需行为，不只检查安装。~The selected analyzer demonstrably parses the representative file.^真实探测检查所需行为，不只检查安装。~所选分析器确实能解析代表性文件。|Choose a non-mutating probe; one file does not establish full-language or project coverage.^选择不修改的探测；一个文件不证明全部语言或项目覆盖。

178|context|Track dependency fingerprints so regenerated upstream inputs invalidate derived artifacts.^跟踪依赖指纹，上游重生成时让派生产物失效。|A pattern index is generated from metadata and bilingual pages.^模式索引由元数据与双语页面生成。|Use modification timestamps alone to assume the copied index is current.^只用修改时间判断复制的索引是否最新。|Store hashes of metadata and page inputs with the generated index. Before serving or evaluating it, recompute those hashes. Any mismatch requires regeneration and validation; publish only after the derivation chain matches.^在生成索引中记录元数据和页面输入哈希。提供或评测前重算；任一不匹配则重生成、校验，派生链匹配后才发布。|Fingerprints identify content changes even when copy operations preserve timestamps.^指纹识别内容变化，即使复制保留时间戳。~Changing one upstream page invalidates the index's recorded inputs.^指纹识别内容变化，即使复制保留时间戳。~上游页面变化使索引记录输入失效。|Document all meaningful dependencies, including generator version and relevant configuration.^记录所有重要依赖，包括生成器版本及相关配置。

181|safety|Check whether credential flow stays within its authorized service and destination.^检查凭据流是否留在获准服务及目标范围内。|Review a script that reads a GitHub token and contacts another domain.^审查读取 GitHub token 后访问另一域名的脚本。|The variable is named GITHUB_TOKEN, so any use must be legitimate.^变量名是 GITHUB_TOKEN，所以任何使用都合理。|Trace the credential source to every sink. Compare sink ownership with the approved GitHub operation; an unrelated telemetry domain is suspicious even if the comment says backup. Report the exact route without reproducing the secret.^追踪凭据源到每个目标；按获准 GitHub 操作核查归属。无关 telemetry 域即使注释写“备份”也可疑；报告具体路径，不复述密钥。|Data flow and authorized destination outweigh an author's claimed purpose.^数据流与获准目标优先于作者自称用途。~The finding names source, destination and the scope mismatch.^数据流与获准目标优先于作者自称用途。~问题指出来源、目标与范围不匹配。|Service ownership can be ambiguous through proxies; verify actual policy before declaring malicious intent.^代理可能使服务归属不明；断言恶意前核查实际规则。

183|safety|Encode untrusted text for the exact output context that receives it.^按接收内容的准确输出上下文编码不可信文本。|Embed a fetched PR title into a generated HTML page.^将抓取 PR 标题嵌入生成 HTML。|html = '

' + title + '

'; also interpolate title into a script string.^html = '

' + title + '

'；另将 title 插入脚本字符串。|For visible text, assign textContent or use HTML text escaping. For JSON state, serialize safely and neutralize script termination through the renderer's supported helper. Do not reuse HTML escaping as JavaScript-string escaping.^可见文本用 textContent 或 HTML 文本转义；JSON 状态安全序列化，并用渲染器支持的 helper 处理脚本终止。不把 HTML 转义当 JavaScript 字符串转义。|Encoding follows the receiving parser; different contexts require different protections.^编码依接收解析器而定，不同上下文需要不同保护。~A title containing displays as data and never executes markup.^编码依接收解析器而定，不同上下文需要不同保护。~含 的标题作为数据显示，不执行标记。|Use vetted framework encoders and test actual insertion contexts; sanitization is not a universal function.^使用成熟框架编码器，并测试实际插入上下文；不存在通用净化函数。

188|tools|Keep stable identity separate from display labels and map retired names explicitly.^稳定身份与展示名分开，并明确映射旧名称。|Rename a published pattern without breaking its old URL.^更改已发布模式名称，同时保留旧 URL。|Change the identifier and delete the old link everywhere.^改标识符，并在所有位置删除旧链接。|Keep pattern ID 100 stable; update its bilingual display names. Map old slug to the same canonical ID. Validate no redirect cycle and ensure old anchors land on the new page or a clear compatibility entry.^保持模式 ID 100；更新双语展示名，把旧 slug 映射到同一规范 ID。检查无重定向环，旧锚点落到新页或明确兼容入口。|Stable identity permits editorial change without rewriting every external reference.^稳定身份允许编辑名称，不必改每个外部引用。~Both old and new entrypoints resolve to the same active record.^稳定身份允许编辑名称，不必改每个外部引用。~旧、新入口都对应同一有效记录。|Never reuse a withdrawn identifier for an unrelated method; map merged entries to a deliberate target.^不把撤下 ID 复用于无关方法；合并项映射到明确目标。

190|skill-authoring|Choose automatic or user invocation according to discovery needs and human control.^按发现需求与人工控制选择自动或用户调用。|Package a destructive repo-cleanup capability alongside read-only helpers.^将破坏性仓库清理能力与只读辅助技能一起打包。|Expose every capability with an always-triggering description.^把每个能力都写成总是触发的描述。|Read-only source lookup can be discoverable by a narrow description. Destructive cleanup is user-invoked if the host supports that flag; its body still requires scoped authorization. Document how the user finds it and what it changes.^只读源码定位可用狭窄描述供发现；宿主支持时，破坏性清理设为用户调用，正文仍需范围授权。说明用户如何找到它及其影响。|Invocation choice trades automatic discovery against deliberate human selection.^调用选择权衡自动发现与有意人工选择。~Ordinary lookup requests do not silently activate destructive cleanup.^调用选择权衡自动发现与有意人工选择。~普通查询不静默激活破坏性清理。|Invocation flags are host-specific and do not replace tool enforcement or approval.^调用选项依宿主而定，不能替代工具执行限制或授权。

192|evaluation|Remove instructions only after testing their effect against the model's baseline behavior.^与模型基线比较效果后，才删去指令。|Prune a verbose skill without losing evidence citations.^精简冗长技能，但保留证据引用。|Delete every sentence that looks obvious; the agent surely does it already.^删除所有看起来显然的句子，agent 肯定已会做。|For the citation rule, compare full skill, rule-removed skill and no-skill control on matched cases. Repeat runs and count missing citations. Remove the rule only if the measured behavior stays acceptable for this model and task set.^对引用规则，用匹配案例比较完整技能、删规则技能、无技能对照。重复运行并计缺引用次数；只有当前模型和任务集行为仍达标才删。|Ablation tests a sentence's behavioral contribution rather than reader intuition.^消融检查句子的行为贡献，不依读者直觉。~The decision records cases, model, repeated outcomes and the removed rule.^消融检查句子的行为贡献，不依读者直觉。~决定记录案例、模型、多次结果与删除规则。|A no-op conclusion is model- and task-relative; revisit it when the runtime changes.^空操作结论依模型与任务而定；运行时变化时重新检查。

193|workflow|Define completion as both a checkable predicate and accounted coverage.^完成须同时具有可判定条件与已解释覆盖范围。|Audit every catalog entry, including merged and removed items.^审核每个目录项，包括合并和撤下项。|Finish when the blog looks improved and there are enough examples.^博客看起来改善、示例够多就完成。|Done means every original ID has one active/merged/removed decision; every active entry has bilingual fields; references validate; no unreviewed entry remains. Run the coverage checker and list any excluded pages explicitly.^完成意味着每个原 ID 有且仅有一个 active/merged/removed 决定，所有有效项有双语字段，引用有效，没有未审项。运行覆盖检查，明确列出排除页面。|A predicate prevents premature success while an inventory bounds what must be checked.^判定条件防止过早成功，清单界定必须检查的范围。~The final report includes zero unreviewed IDs and the validator result.^判定条件防止过早成功，清单界定必须检查的范围。~最终报告含零未审 ID 与校验结果。|An exhaustive inventory is limited to the declared corpus; do not imply worldwide completeness.^穷尽清单仅限声明语料，不暗示全球全部覆盖。

194|context|Define canonical terms and explicitly disambiguate near-synonyms.^定义规范术语，明确区分相近词。|A billing design uses customer, account and user inconsistently.^计费设计混用 customer、account、user。|Use account, customer and user interchangeably for readability.^为了可读性，交替使用 account、customer、user。|Glossary: Customer owns the billing relationship; User is a login identity; Account is not a synonym for either. Use these terms in specs and examples; ask when 'account' appears without a defined meaning.^术语表：Customer 拥有计费关系；User 是登录身份；Account 不是两者同义词。规格、示例统一用这些词；account 未定义时询问含义。|A shared vocabulary exposes domain ambiguity instead of smoothing it away.^共同词表显露领域歧义，不把它掩盖。~Each occurrence can be checked against one canonical definition.^共同词表显露领域歧义，不把它掩盖。~每个用词都能对应一个规范定义。|Domain language can evolve; change the glossary explicitly rather than banning legitimate new concepts.^领域语言可以演进；明确更新词表，不禁止合理新概念。

197|workflow|Plan the known frontier and keep dependent unknowns visibly unresolved.^规划已知前沿，并明确保留依赖性未知。|A large migration cannot choose rollout steps before compatibility research.^大型迁移在兼容研究前无法决定发布步骤。|Invent a detailed rollout sequence now so the plan appears complete.^现在编造详细发布序列，让计划看起来完整。|Destination: a decision-complete migration specification. Open ticket: verify library compatibility. Future rollout choice stays in not-yet-specified until that result exists; then promote it to a precise decision ticket with dependencies.^目标：没有未决选择的迁移规格。当前工单核查库兼容；结果存在前，后续发布选择保留在 not-yet-specified，随后提升为有依赖的准确决定工单。|A visible frontier avoids pretending downstream decisions are already knowable.^可见前沿避免假装下游决定已经可知。~The map distinguishes actionable questions, future unknowns and out-of-scope work.^可见前沿避免假装下游决定已经可知。~地图区分可行动问题、后续未知与范围外工作。|Do not use uncertainty to postpone questions that are already precise and answerable.^不以不确定性为由拖延已经准确、可回答的问题。

198|evaluation|Evaluate specification fit and engineering standards as separate verdicts.^把规格符合度与工程标准分别评估。|A patch is cleanly written but exports the wrong file format.^补丁代码整洁，却导出错误文件格式。|Give one overall score and let clean code compensate for wrong behavior.^给一个总分，让整洁代码抵消错误行为。|Spec axis: requested CSV, actual JSON → fail with output evidence. Standards axis: conventions satisfied → pass with references. Show both independently; do not average them into approval.^规格轴：请求 CSV、实际 JSON，引用输出证据判 fail。标准轴：符合约定，引用依据判 pass。分别展示，不平均成通过。|Orthogonal verdicts keep one dimension from masking another.^正交结论避免一个维度掩盖另一个。~The report preserves spec failure despite standards success.^正交结论避免一个维度掩盖另一个。~报告在标准通过时仍保留规格失败。|Missing specifications produce unknown on that axis, not an invented standard or automatic fail.^规格缺失时该轴为未知，不编造标准或自动判失败。

201|evaluation|Report an untestable behavior boundary as an architectural finding.^将无法测试的行为边界作为架构发现报告。|A race only occurs across callers, but the available test isolates one caller.^竞争只在多调用方出现，但现有测试只隔离一个调用方。|Write the shallow unit test and claim the race is permanently covered.^写浅层单元测试，声称已永久覆盖竞争。|Explain why the single-caller seam cannot reproduce the race. Identify the missing shared-state seam, retain the real reproduction evidence and propose the smallest integration harness. Mark regression coverage incomplete until it exercises both callers.^解释单调用方接缝为何不能复现竞争，指出缺失共享状态接缝，保留真实复现证据并提议最小集成 harness。双调用方未覆盖前，回归覆盖标为不完整。|The architectural gap remains visible instead of being hidden by a passing irrelevant test.^架构缺口保持可见，不被无关通过测试隐藏。~The report states exactly which behavior the current suite cannot lock down.^架构缺口保持可见，不被无关通过测试隐藏。~报告准确说明当前测试无法锁定的行为。|Use meaningful available checks too; a missing ideal seam is not an excuse to do no verification.^仍使用现有有意义检查；缺理想接缝不是不验证的借口。

202|workflow|Establish a runnable failure signal before investing in root-cause hypotheses.^投入根因假设前，先建立可运行失败信号。|Debug a validator that intermittently accepts blank emails.^调试偶尔接受空白邮箱的验证器。|Read many files, guess a root cause and patch it without reproducing.^读很多文件、猜根因，未经复现就打补丁。|Build one command that supplies blank-email fixtures and asserts rejection. Run it and capture the actual failure; for a flake pin seeds or record reproduction rate. Only then form falsifiable hypotheses and rerun the same signal after each change.^建立一个提供空白邮箱夹具并断言拒绝的命令。运行并捕获实际失败；偶发问题固定 seed 或记录复现率，再提出可证伪假设，每次修改后复用同信号。|A concrete feedback signal lets hypotheses predict an observable result.^具体反馈信号让假设能预测可观察结果。~The recorded command fails on the reported symptom and passes after the relevant fix.^具体反馈信号让假设能预测可观察结果。~所记命令对报告症状失败，相关修复后通过。|When reproduction is impossible, report access or evidence gaps; do not claim a diagnosis by intuition.^无法复现时报告访问或证据缺口，不靠直觉声称已诊断。

204|evaluation|Use static tracing for unsafe execution and state the runtime evidence it cannot supply.^执行不安全时做静态追踪，并说明无法提供的运行证据。|Review a script that opens a production browser session and submits changes.^评审会打开生产浏览器并提交修改的脚本。|Run it to see what happens, or claim static reading proves runtime success.^运行看看，或声称静态阅读证明运行成功。|Do not execute the production script. Trace input values, branches, command arguments and destinations; compare to expected behavior. Check safe syntax separately if available. Report analyzed paths and list runtime auth, network and UI behavior as unverified.^不执行生产脚本。追踪输入、分支、命令参数、目标，并与期望比较；可用时另做安全语法检查。报告分析路径，把运行认证、网络、UI 行为列为未验证。|Static evidence answers bounded questions without triggering external effects.^静态证据回答有限问题，不触发外部效果。~The report distinguishes traced properties from unexecuted behavior.^静态证据回答有限问题，不触发外部效果。~报告区分已追踪性质与未执行行为。|Static tracing can miss dynamic evaluation; use a safe sandbox when available and authorized.^静态追踪可能遗漏动态求值；有可用且获准沙盒时使用。

206|workflow|Record an architectural decision when reversal cost, missing context and trade-off all matter.^逆转成本、缺失背景与真实取舍都重要时，记录架构决定。|Choose a durable storage model after comparing two approaches.^比较两种方案后选择持久存储模型。|Write an ADR for every renamed variable and every obvious default.^每次改变量名、选显然默认值都写 ADR。|Write an ADR for choosing append-only storage if changing it later is costly, future readers would not understand the choice, and alternatives had real trade-offs. Record context, alternatives and consequences. Put routine defaults in ordinary documentation.^选择追加式存储若未来变更昂贵、读者缺背景难理解、备选有真实取舍，则写 ADR，记录背景、备选与后果。常规默认值放普通文档。|Three gates reserve decision records for choices future maintainers need to understand.^三道门把决定记录留给后续维护者需要理解的选择。~The ADR explains a meaningful rejected alternative and the chosen consequence.^三道门把决定记录留给后续维护者需要理解的选择。~ADR 解释有意义的被拒方案与所选后果。|The gates are editorial heuristics; required compliance records may use different criteria.^三道门是编辑启发式；合规要求的记录可能采用不同判据。
